consequences: No new MCP tool or schema; agents see template names in the tool description. .sati/templates/ is the one folder people edit by hand; rules and workflow say so.
context: Phase 7c: event, campaign and release plans. Options: event-specific screens, a template_apply MCP tool, or a template option on the existing roadmap_upsert.
decision: Templates are Markdown in .sati/templates/ (three starters built in). Applying one creates a milestone and staged tasks in one transaction. MCP uses roadmap_upsert with template; CLI sati template; UI New plan. A same-named plan is refused.
title: Templates are Markdown files applied through roadmap_upsert, not a new tool
